data.Description: Subsea tieback to Snorre N-template. Phase 1: 1 producer (CAP-X ST from 34/4-19 S) + 1 injector (4-slot template). Tarbert + Rannoch formations, Brent Group.
data.Purpose: Steward Omega Sør development from SSVP through DG3/DG4 to first oil (Jan 2029). Adapted CVP process for subsea tieback / low pressure / brownfield.

LifecycleEvents.Name: Project created post exploration
LifecycleEvents.Remark: Concept screening validated after 34/4-19 S exploration well. Higher flow rates observed → more wells needed.

LifecycleEvents.Name: Exploration well results ingested
LifecycleEvents.Remark: 34/4-19 S: confirmed Brent Gp pay in Tarbert+Rannoch. Flow rates exceed pre-drill P50. Unable to take water sample (barium unknown).

LifecycleEvents.Name: Layout alternative — 4-slot template replaces injection CAP-X
LifecycleEvents.Remark: VPbO recommendation: replace injection CAP-X with 4-slot template. Provides +1 producer on Alfa, 2 future slots for Beta.

LifecycleEvents.Name: Simulation model delivered
LifecycleEvents.Remark: Recoverable P90/Mean/P10 = 3.3/5.4/8.0 MSm³. RF range 16–43%. Model dated 10th June.

LifecycleEvents.Name: Economics delivered
LifecycleEvents.Remark: Phase 1+2: NPV 116 MUSD (EQN share), IRR 62%, breakeven 25 USD/bbl. Cutoff 2050.

LifecycleEvents.Name: Barium scale risk raised to critical
LifecycleEvents.Remark: Unable to sample formation water from 34/4-19 S. Ba content unknown. Decision tree: <50 mg/L proceed; 50-100 evaluate; >100 concept change. Pilot well mandatory.

LifecycleEvents.Name: SSVP presentation delivered
LifecycleEvents.Remark: PVP assessment completed. Subsurface maturity at VPBO level. Remaining uncertainty: RF, permeability, structural understanding.

LifecycleEvents.Name: Preliminary well plans finalized
LifecycleEvents.Remark: Pilot → producer (ST from 34/4-19 S via CAP-X) → injector (from template). Core planned for deformation band assessment.

ActivityStates.Remark: STOIIP P90/Mean/P10 = 15.8/19.3/22.9 MSm³. Recoverable 3.3/5.4/8.0 MSm³. RF 16–43%.
NPV 116 MUSD (EQN), IRR 62%, breakeven 25 USD/bbl. Cutoff 2050.
1 producer (CAP-X ST from 34/4-19 S) + 1 injector (4-slot template). Pilot first.
1 injector + 2 producers on Alfa. WAG-ready template, no gas line in Phase 1.
8 risks registered (PIMS PM978). Critical: barium scale (#00061), injectivity.
RMS model in RDDMS maap/omegas. Framework: Top Tarbert, velocity model, fracture zones.
4-slot template south of CAP-X. 8" prod flowline, 6" WI flowline. Tieback to Snorre N.
Pilot from template to deeper structure: OWC, Ba content, Tarbert sand presence, deformation bands.
WPC / DG0 approval pending pilot well outcome.

LastActivityState.Remark: SSVP completed. 8/9 checklist items done. Pilot well scope in progress.
